DEPARTMENT OF BIORESOURCES
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
SRINAGAR
Peer Abdul Haseeb Shah, Ph. D.
(DST-INSPIRE Faculty/Assistant Professor)
Department of Bioresources, University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar- 190006, Kashmir
(J&K), India. E-mail: abdulhaseeb@kashmiruniversity.ac.in; M+91-9596528258
No. F.(Rec-ANRF)BRES/KU26/2
Dated: 01-04-2026
Interview Notice for the JRF position
This is for the information of all the candidates who have applied in response to
advertisement No. F. (Rec-DBT/ANRF)Biores/KU-26/1 Dated: 23.03.2026 for JRF position in
the ANRF project entitled “Pharmaceutical co-crystals/salts of azole antifungals. Development and
investigation of their physicochemical and anti-fungal properties and cytotoxicity studies” that their
interview will be held on 07-04-2026 (Tuesday) in the office chamber of the Head,
Department of Bioresources at 10.00 am. All the eligible candidates have been informed
about the same through email as well.
Further TA/DA will not be provided for appearing in the interview.
The candidates should bring their original documents/testimonials along with them on
the date of the interview.
Sd/-
Dr. Peer Abdul Haseeb Shah
Principal Investigator
Department of Bioresources
Copy to:
1. Dean, School of Biological Sciences
2. Head, Department of Bioresources
3. Director, IT&SS, with the request to upload the notification on the official website of the

4. Notice Board; File
